ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This is an accelerated 8 week course and may require more time commitment per week than a traditional 16 week course. Go to the following URL: https://courses.las.illinois.edu to access the Moodle course management system login page This section will also have one or more proctored online exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
